description: Big Tower Tiny Square is a precision platformer created by Evil Objective. Dodge bullets and leap over lava pits as you make your way to the top of the tower to save your pineapple.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Make It Boom!
description: Explosive puzzle adventure that challenges your strategy and timing skills! Your mission is simple: burst firecrackers to create thrilling chain reactions and clear each level. But beware—this isn’t just any ordinary puzzle game!

title: Tech Mart Simulator
description: Tech Mart Simulator is a detailed retail management game where you build and run your own cutting-edge electronics store. Set up shelves, organize stock, scan products, and assist customers to keep your business thriving.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Back 2 School Makeover
description: Embrace the nostalgia and dive into our Back 2 School Makeover game, where you can fashionably express yourself, experiment with stunning looks, and relish into the feeling of heading back to school with style! Embark on a fabulous journey with our character, Amelia, as she transforms from an edgy e-girl to a chic, school-ready fashionista. Revamp her entire look starting with a haircare routine and a new haircut, a complete skincare routine, and a new, school makeup.

title: Color Wavee
description: Color wave game is very challenging and tests adrenaline. The ball will continue to move without stopping, and you will control the ball to avoid direct collisions with various ball movements so you don't get bored playing this game

title: Granny Pills - Defend Cactuses
description:
2075 year. After the invasion of aliens, there was almost no life and oxygen left on Earth. The only plant that survived are cacti. The aliens want to destroy or steal all the cactuses to stop the live on Earth.

The brave Granny who grows her cactuses on the road (so that they can receive rays of light) should protect them from aliens. She discovered that the aliens are afraid of human pills, and she has a huge amount of them, as well as a shotgun loaded in case of emergency.

title: Sandwich Runner
description: Sandwich Runner is a fun game. Collect ingredients on the way to the goal, how high will it reach? The diner is very hungry and he can't wait to eat. Collect steaks, chicken thighs, fried eggs, and sushi. Be careful to avoid bad food like mold and rot or it will make the diner sick! Red peppers will make the diner spitfire! Can you keep the diner happy and pass the level? Good luck!

title: Water Junk Warriors
description: Water Junk Warriors is a vibrant eco-adventure game where players dive into polluted waterways to clean up human-made junk and restore the natural balance of riverbanks, beaches, and urban canals. Armed with clever tools and a passion for nature, players collect floating trash, unlock animated milestones, and witness the environment come back to life, one subgoal at a time.

title: Stickman Adventure
description: This is an adventure that will take you through time and space! Along the way, you'll encounter various traps and monsters; you'll need to defeat them and rescue your friends. Come on, Hero, a whole new world awaits!

title: Survival Racing: Extreme Road
description:
Imagine that the time has come when ordinary racing is no longer enough adrenaline temptation. In a world where extreme sports are at the peak of popularity, a new competition has appeared - Survival Racing: Extreme Road.

Overcome obstacles, avoid traps and fight your rivals to reach the finish line first. Your goal is not only to win the race, but also to survive in the face of fierce competition.

title: Find The Cat - Cat Search
description: Discover the exciting world of finding hidden cats in this original puzzle game! Look for cats on black and white backgrounds by tapping on them to complete levels. With each stage, you will unlock new places and receive unique challenges that will test your attentiveness and observation skills.

title: Sokoban
description: Sokoban is a classic Japanese puzzle-solving game in which you need to move all of the boxes into the correct locations. The boxes will be pushed in single directions by the character, meaning you can move them left, right, up, or down.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Gas Station
description: Gas Station is a detailed and engaging tycoon game where you transform a rundown gas station into a thriving business empire. Manage daily operations, fix up old cars, expand your services, and build your legacy as a successful entrepreneur.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Tailed Demon Slayer
description: Tailed Demon Slayer is an action-packed idle RPG where you join a brave hero fighting to reclaim Bestia from undead bosses. You’ll explore dangerous dungeons, unlock powerful skills, and collect unique weapons to sharpen your strength.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Mahjong Royal
description: Start your new favourite oriental solitaire puzzle. This classic Mahjong will captivate you and keep you playing, and you'll become a master in no time.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Crazy Plane Landing
description:
Flying is easy - but can you stick the landing?

Get into one of the amazing flying machines and launch as high as you can. This part is easy… well, fairly easy. Not that anyone can do it. But you can. Surely you do!

What’s really interesting is what happens next. Will you crash? Or will you somehow make it a perfect landing?

title: Doodle Road
description: Doodle Road is an imaginative and captivating 2D casual game that combines creativity with problem-solving. In this fun browser game, your primary objective is to draw a path that will successfully guide a car from the starting point to the finish line.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Falling Fruits
description: Falling Fruits is an incremental clicker game where you destroy falling fruit using attack towers. Earn cash from splattering the fruit to buy various upgrades and new towers.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Stickman Weapon Master
description: Stickman Weapon Master is a fierce action-combat game where you rise as a lone warrior against a tyrannical lord. Wield a variety of deadly weapons, each with distinct styles, and master fluid, intense melee battles.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Unpuzzle: Tap Away Puzzle Game
description: Unpuzzle: Tap Away Puzzle Game is a brain-teaser game where you swipe blocks to solve intricate puzzles. Boasting over 1000 levels, each move tests your logic and critical thinking skills.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game
